name: Rarity
source:
Rarity is a unicorn pony who resides in Ponyville, and is one of the main characters of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic. She is the older sister of Sweetie Belle with whom she often disagrees. Rarity works as both a fashion designer and as a seamstress at her own shop, Carousel Boutique. She has a white Persian cat named Opalescence. Her personality traits consist of elegance and generosity, for which she represents the element of generosity.

[Taken from [url=http://mlp.wikia.com/wiki/Rarity]MLP Wiki[/url]]
